steps.text: Set up: three keys, one of them used for a Link
Open Settings: all three are active, so there is no Revoked keys section for them yet
Revoke two keys from the active list
Open the section: revoked rows have Enable and Delete and no Revoke; the list scrolls
Enable a revoked key: it moves back to the active list and authenticates again
Delete asks for confirmation; Cancel keeps the key
Delete the revoked key, and an active key
Usage keeps the deleted key's Links under its stored name, marked Deleted
A body that is not valid JSON gets a clear 400 (what zsh's url-quote-magic produces)
